consumer: An external graphing tool reading the snapshot's stored_kcal field, asking 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie reservoir at this tick so I can plot it over time?'
scope: The single raw scalar reservoir value on the avatar (whole-character stored_kcal ground truth), not a percentage, threshold predicate, or display-filtered view
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() straight into the JSON; get_stored_kcal() returns the avatar's raw stored calorie count, the authoritative simulation-state value the graph needs
divergence: A character at very high calorie stores where kcal_percent saturates/clamps near its cap: the raw stored_kcal keeps rising (correct for a history graph) while kcal_percent would flatten, so relying on a derived ratio would mis-plot the curve, but the raw getter exposed here reports the true value
